executive_summary: For 25 November 2025, air quality in Mumbai is classified as elevated with a moderate area band. The area average is 43 ug/m3, while the population-weighted average reaches 54 ug/m3. The highest recorded cell value is 79 ug/m3 near Bandra Kurla Complex.
risk_context: With 94 percent of the area above the WHO 24-hour standard of 25 ug/m3, populations experience sustained exposure. Primary identified pollution sources across the hotspots include traffic, power plants, and dense urban activities.
recommendations: Monitor traffic emissions strictly around Sion and Chembur hotspots.
Evaluate power plant operations contributing to local pollutant concentrations.
Maintain ongoing surveillance as no exceedances are forecasted within the next 24 hours.
